F7.why: Candidate 1 describes the same defect at the same site: early returns (including line 96) leave completions armed on the stack-backed cq/recv_op/t1 after the driver unwinds, causing corruption or a bad callback, and prescribes cancellation cleanup.

extra_titles: The new example uses POSIX-only `std.c` calls, so `zig build examples` breaks on Windows
The flooder can write to a descriptor the driver has already closed
A reproduction does not stop the other drivers, so exit 2 arrives long after the SPURIOUS line
The clean report counts the requested budget, not the work the probe actually did
A failed spawn leaves running tasks pointing at freed memory
